scope.geometry: Test Euclidean distance from a query point to the full untrimmed geometric ellipse locus
scope.tolerance_policy: Require an explicit finite nonnegative caller-supplied linear tolerance and accept the inclusive boundary; no ACIS/modeler default is inferred
scope.solver_policy: Reuse the ellipse closest-point multiplier solver; permit a representative tied nearest point only inside the distance-only implementation so the predicate can correctly measure nonunique cases without publishing a point
scope.numeric_policy: Use std::hypot on the finite query-to-candidate displacement to avoid avoidable squared-distance overflow
scope.refusal_policy: Malformed/nonfinite ellipse or query, invalid frame/tolerance, unresolved numeric case, overflowing displacement, or distance outside tolerance returns false
non_claims: native ACIS parameter direction or edge parameter range
finite edge trim, loop, or pcurve evaluation
native CAD or independent-kernel semantic qualification

validation.language_standard_probe: Changed translation unit compiles with -std=c++14 when suppressing the pre-existing inline-variable extension warning; the current CMake project sets C++17 and strict C++14 compilation is blocked by inline constexpr variables already present in src/drw_base.h
